W01

Institution sign-in

/app/sign-in
Roles: guestScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: P41

Identify the institution and hand credentials to its sign-in service, preserving a safe academic destination. Whiteboard never presents a password form.

Stay hereContinue to institution
Permissions
  • Guest can discover institution names only.
  • Untrusted return parameters must never become arbitrary external redirects.
  • Roles and enrollment arrive from authoritative records; no self-selected privilege.
Responsive
  • Centered form becomes full-width with readable margins at 320 CSS pixels.
  • Long institution names and hosts wrap; primary button follows the selected result.
Accessibility
  • Search is a labelled combobox with keyboard selection and announced result count.
  • Authentication permits paste and password managers at the institutional service; no cognitive puzzle is added.
Data
  • Institution directory fixture: identifier, display name, trusted host, support URL.
  • Validated internal return context; no credentials in logs or fixtures.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • A deep link to an assignment returns to its access check after W02.
  • Typing an unknown name leaves Continue unavailable with an explicit reason.
  • A failed handoff never renders authenticated navigation or invents a session.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
  • IdP, institution and authentication protocol remain partner decisions. HTML uses an explicitly labelled simulated redirect.
